prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create exactly one image from the prompt below. The first 1 attached image(s) are inputs the prompt refers to. Do not edit any files, do not run shell commands and do not write code. After generating, reply with only the word DONE.

PROMPT:
Storyboard panel, beat 1 of 5 (the player walks in, before the cutscene starts). Image 1 is the greybox layout of this exact camera view: keep the camera position, the framing and where everything stands. Inside a round, flooded stone observatory at night: in the middle foreground a small player-sized explorer with simple blocky proportions and a backpack, seen from behind, walking toward the middle; in the middle distance a stone pedestal standing in ankle-deep water with a small glowing amber orb (the beacon) on top; right behind it a huge kneeling stone statue with its head bowed, about three times the explorer's height, in a narrow shaft of moonlight from a round opening in the dome; on the left wall a tall arched doorway with a soft cool glow (the exit). The statue looks like part of the building. Exactly one explorer and one statue; no face visible on the statue.

STORYBOARD LOCK: One storyboard panel for a cutscene: exactly one frame of one shot, drawn as a clear staging proposal, not as polished key art. Shows the named shot size and camera angle, the subject placed where the panel says (left, middle or right of frame), its eyeline and direction of travel, the named action at the named moment, and the light direction. Same characters, props and places as the game, at true scale to each other; readable silhouettes and simple shapes over detail. Wide landscape composition made for a 16:9 crop, nothing essential near the frame edges. No text, letters, numbers, arrows, speech bubbles, panel borders, letterbox bars, user-interface elements or watermark (camera moves and notes are written outside the image).

WORLD STYLE LOCK: <the game's art style in exact words: rendering (e.g. stylized hand-painted, toy plastic, cel-shaded), shape language, proportions, material look, palette (named colours or hex), lighting>. No text, no logos, no watermark. Not resembling any existing franchise.
